verdict.rationale: Elastic documents APM tracing of every request across microservices, APM agents that collect metrics alongside traces, and a unified logs/metrics/traces solution that can surface correlations. That points to end-to-end request debugging across signals. However, no evidence explicitly describes navigating from a specific trace span to its correlated logs and metrics. missing for 10: documented span-to-logs navigation, documented span-to-metrics navigation, trace-ID/log correlation mechanism, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end

citations.quote: Elastic APM traces every request across microservices and APIs pinpointing code-level latency.
Elastic APM agents automatically pick up basic host-level metrics and agent-specific metrics
the ability to surface correlations and root causes
